purpose: Explain observed cold-start consumption cost within the selected vehicle's returned drive window, with cold/warm cohorts, temperature evidence, parking strata, sample coverage and ranked opportunities.
primaryGoal: Compare distance-weighted consumption after long versus short parking gaps without confusing bounded observational evidence, missing measurements or insufficient samples with a causal warm-up penalty.

dataSources.sourceOwnership: web\src\api\hooks\useDriving.ts:104-128 owns typed query, window-scoped keys, safeArray, AbortSignal forwarding, vehicle enablement and STALE_TIMES.FAST; internal\api\router.go:3463-3464 registers driveHandler.ListByVehicle.
dataSources.behavior: One capped request; no pagination or outside-window predecessor request. Server filtering, ordering, returned completeness and actual payload were not exercised. Hook clamps the limit to 1..1000.
dataSources.trust: Page derives historical useDataState, passes only fatalError into sections, and retains data on failed/paused refresh alongside StaleRefreshWarning.

dataSources.sourceOwnership: Existing workspace hooks and header controls; /cold-start is listed in web\src\lib\workspaceScope.ts:34.
dataSources.behavior: No second vehicle or range picker. No vehicle returns NoVehicleSelected. The page requests start/end calendar strings rather than the hook's precise startInstant/endInstantExclusive contract.

dataSources.sourceOwnership: Driving domain deterministic model, not a backend analytics endpoint.
dataSources.behavior: Sorts valid starts chronologically. Measured finite positive energy and distance >=1000 m qualify. Gap uses preceding returned drive's end or duration fallback. Warm <=3600 s, cold >=21600 s, intervening gaps ambiguous. Invalid/negative gaps and missing predecessor remain unclassified. Cohorts are distance weighted; aggregate delta requires >=5 drives per cohort. UTC monthly descriptive rollups, five gap buckets, measured-temperature cold/warm scatter and top positive drive-level baseline differences remain distinct.

dataSources.sourceOwnership: Existing currency/settings, useUnits display preferences, numeric formatting and localization owners.
dataSources.behavior: Cost exists only when penalty energy and a finite usable configured positive rate are available by the page's current checks; page checks rate non-null and >0, not explicit finiteness. Wh becomes kWh only for configured electricity-rate arithmetic. Display helper converts Wh/km to selected distance efficiency; raw drive m/Wh/s/C are retained. Model's derived Wh/km is an explicit existing aggregate contract, not a new wire field.

Comparison also uses NestedDrivingBrief for three cohort measurements. Shared OperationalBrief internals and generic signed-efficiency handling are unverified.

components.name: ColdWarmComparison / ColdStartMethodology / ColdStartOpportunities
components.detail: Three named region GlassPanels retain methodology, coverage, cap warning, weighted comparison, two MetricBars, recommendations and ranked top-five opportunities. UI primitives include Badge, HelpTooltip, PanelTitle, Text, MetricValue and MetricLabel.

components.name: MonthlyColdStartChart / ParkingGapDistribution / TemperatureEfficiencyChart -> ChartContainer
components.detail: Category chart imports; monthly cold/warm consumption lines plus sample bars; five labeled gap buckets with shares; cold/warm temperature scatter with distance marker size and freezing reference. Named accessible figures, dataColumns/fallback tables, image export and monthly/temperature chart keys exist. exportData and fullscreen are not supplied by these callsites; do not infer CSV or fullscreen as existing page actions.

components.name: ColdStartSectionBody / StaleRefreshWarning / QueryError / EmptyState / Skeleton / NoVehicleSelected
components.detail: Per-panel loading/fatal-error gates retain shells; charts use own local branches. Shared retained-data notice distinguishes blocked offline refresh and refresh failure, with retry and polite live status.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Original four-card KPI renderer remains barrel-exported, while this mounted page uses ColdStartBrief. Brief imports its props through a type-only ComponentProps dependency; this does not mount the older renderer. Repository-wide unusedness was not investigated.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep the current OperationalBrief pipeline authoritative for this page; assess other callers before removing or moving the existing prop contract. Do not revive the older cards as a modernization shortcut.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Non-chart domain panels reuse a domain state gate; the three charts independently repeat local fatal/empty branches inside ChartContainer.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Prefer existing ChartContainer error/onRetry/empty contracts where behavior is equivalent, while retaining each source-specific empty explanation and complete fallback/export behavior; no new state library.

responsive.verified: Source only; no viewport or mounted visual validation.
responsive.existingStrategy: Analysis rows stack until xl, then become 3/2 spans. Panel padding changes at sm; comparison's inner content reflows at lg. Charts use ResponsiveContainer and bounded shared viewports. No domain sections are omitted on mobile.

issues.detail: Three confidence counters stay in fixed equal columns at every width. The opportunities metric row also stays grid-cols-3 at ColdStartOpportunities.tsx:126; long translated labels, energy strings and large counts may crowd at 320px or 200% text.
issues.fix: Validate narrow allocated width and text zoom; allow local wrapping/stacking at small widths without hiding the numerator/threshold, classified count, distance, temperature or energy.

issues.detail: A fixed 112px category axis plus plot margins competes with narrow width. Monthly dual axes and top-right four-entry legend similarly constrain space; scatter has a 62px axis. Actual overlap is unverified.
issues.fix: Test all ten contract widths, shell allocation and long labels; use existing chart layout capabilities or local axis/legend reflow, preserving every series and data-table column.

accessibility.verified: Source semantics only; keyboard, assistive technology, target geometry, effective contrast, forced colors and reduced motion unverified.
strengths: Named region panels and section labels; decorative local icons aria-hidden.
Charts supply localized ariaLabel and full dataColumns; ChartContainer:765-845 renders a semantic fallback table and exposes it under forced colors.
ColdStartSectionBody:33-40 gives initial loading role=status with localized label.
StaleRefreshWarning:102-120 supplies polite status and shared Button retry.
Monthly series and parking buckets have textual names/counts; temperature data table includes group, date, temperature, consumption and distance.

issues.detail: Both cohort MetricBars pass missing whPerKm as 0 (also line 147). The visible sublabel is an em dash but shared MetricBar treats the input as a measurement and announces aria-valuenow=0. Shared MetricBar already supports null and a localized No reading state.
issues.fix: Pass the nullable cohort measurement directly; keep the shared null track/accessibility contract and avoid representing absent cohort consumption as measured zero.

issues.detail: The existing interactive legend overrides shared Button sizing with h-auto min-h-0 p-0. Monthly and temperature charts consume this owner; effective mobile touch size and spacing exceptions were not measured.
issues.fix: Shared owner to verify target size/spacing and focus for multi-series legends, then extend existing legend hit-area behavior only if needed; do not build a page-only legend.

states.initial: sourceState.status==='initial' suppresses measured summary operands, renders section skeletons and chart loading geometry; methodology/comparison badges are outside these loading gates.
states.noVehicle: NoVehicleSelected replaces the page when vehicleId is null; the underlying drive query remains disabled.
states.empty: Summary explicitly explains no usable known-gap drives; comparison has no-cohort empty; methodology no-returned-drive empty; each chart distinguishes its absent evidence; opportunities separate insufficient samples, nonpositive aggregate delta and no positive individual differences.
states.insufficient: Consumption observations may remain descriptive; aggregate delta and energy remain null until >=5 observations in each cohort. Monthly trends explicitly do not establish monthly penalties.
states.unknown: Missing temperatures remain null and are omitted from scatter, not mapped to 0 C. Missing efficiency displays an em dash, except the MetricBar accessibility defect recorded once above. Missing rate suppresses cost.
states.fatalError: fatalError only drives section gates and independent retry controls; page query is also supplied for shared freshness display, not as an explicit page-wide error replacement.
states.staleOffline: useDataState and StaleRefreshWarning keep returned data under refresh failure or paused/offline refresh. Main summary receives retained=true; the nested comparison brief is not passed retained, so can say Returned evidence beside a global retained warning.
states.partial: One drive source; partial/unavailable options are not supplied. Missing temperature and unclassified drives are described through analytical coverage, not independent backend source statuses.

issues.detail: Confidence badge renders before initial/fatal content gate. Initial/fatal empty summary therefore displays More samples needed even though the source has not successfully returned. The comparison badge at ColdWarmComparison.tsx:111 is inside its state gate and does not share this exact issue.
issues.fix: Retain badge position but derive loading/unavailable labels from section state before sample confidence; only claim insufficient samples from returned observations.

issues.detail: NestedDrivingBrief supports retained but this caller does not receive/pass it; retained comparisons may announce Returned evidence while the top summary and warning identify retained data.
issues.fix: Thread the existing derived source trust into the domain comparison and pass retained to NestedDrivingBrief, without replacing retained measurements on refresh error.

visualIssues.detail: Comparison panel adds a cyan-to-emerald gradient wash beyond the shared neutral surface. Cohort MetricBars also inherit gradient fill by default. Scoped source scan found one gradient declaration and no explicit neon/glow/pure-white patterns in the nine mounted page/domain TSX files; this is not composed-theme or palette acceptance.
visualIssues.fix: Use the existing neutral panel surface and, where appropriate, MetricBar fill=solid with established semantic/chart colors. Preserve cohort distinction, saved chart palettes and existing Matrix/neon preference identities; do not globally reset user preferences.

visualIssues.detail: Five parking buckets use five CHART_COLORS, while monthly/temperature use shared cohort colors. These are existing palette-backed data distinctions, not proof of fluorescent output; actual saturation, contrast and visual noise were not inspected in a browser.
visualIssues.fix: Review composed palettes before acceptance. Subdue non-data decoration and, only if needed, adopt existing palette semantics without losing five strata or cold/warm legend identity; preserve labels and accessible tables.

architectureIssues.detail: Registered workspace-range page requests calendar start/end instead of startInstant/endInstantExclusive. The shared hook documents precise rolling bounds and calendar timezone conversion; calendar strings cannot preserve a rolling 24-hour instant window. Vehicle-specific timezone is not provided at this callsite.
architectureIssues.fix: Consume existing precise bounds and the established vehicle timezone source, send both through useDrives and show accurate scope; retain cap disclosure and missing predecessor behavior. Verify backend exclusive instant filtering rather than assuming it.

architectureIssues.detail: Help says comparing cohorts isolates the battery/cabin warm-up penalty; takeaway at lines 166-181 attributes warm-up overhead. The model only groups by parking gap and distance weights; temperature scatter is descriptive, not temperature/route/cabin conditioning or causal identification. ColdStartBrief explicitly says not a causal test.
architectureIssues.fix: Align existing localized explanations with observed cohort differences and conditional recommendations, retain thresholds/confidence/temperature context, and do not add invented adjusted models or guaranteed savings.

architectureIssues.detail: StatMetric type is imported from data-display/stat-reference rather than the category barrel; the two domain briefs similarly reference that implementation path. This audit did not inspect whether the category barrel re-exports every required type.
architectureIssues.fix: Use the existing category type contract if exported; otherwise request a narrowly owned shared type export, not another stats implementation.

actions: Existing workspace vehicle selection and header View settings; no competing page pickers.
Source/section retry and non-blocking stale/offline refresh via existing query refetch.
Monthly and temperature legend toggles using existing chartKey/hidden-series persistence.
Chart image export (PNG/SVG/clipboard via shared chart owner) when successful non-loading evidence exists; no supplied exportData CSV contract or explicit fullscreen action at these callsites.
Opportunity entries are observational ranked content, not drive links, vehicle commands or production actions.
dataBehavior: Preserve raw SI m, s, Wh and C in drive data/cache/model; display conversions only at existing unit/format boundaries. Keep derived Wh/km aggregate and numeric stats bridge /1000 to Wh/m.
Preserve query key scope, cancellation, vehicle enablement, safeArray and existing cache/retry/stale policies.
Analyze returned selected window only, not guaranteed full range/lifetime. Preserve <=1000 cap disclosure, first-drive predecessor uncertainty and no invented external predecessor.
Retain actual measured temperature strata; do not invent temperature bands, adjusted causal cohorts, confidence intervals or matched-route comparisons absent from current model.
Retain invalid-start filtering, distance >=1000m, finite positive energy, chronological predecessor matching, invalid/negative gap exclusion and ambiguous band.
Preserve >=5 each support threshold, nullable withheld claims, signed cold-minus-warm delta, nonnegative total estimated extra energy and opportunities only for supported positive penalty.
Preserve weighted baseline, UTC month semantics, drive counts and separate descriptive monthly versus supported aggregate claims.
Preserve stable chart keys, series identity, unit/locale settings, missing-value dashes, existing ordered lists and all specialist explanations.
Never discard retained data on refresh failure/offline; unavailable is not zero, fixture data or causal proof.
